Technician-workstation WPF app used to generate WinPE boot images and prepare USB
storage devices.

Deploy it with the MSI: it installs per-machine and takes the tenant configuration as
install properties, so there is no need to repackage the payload per tenant. See
`docs/setup-instructions.md` > "Deploying the Media Builder with Intune" for the full
deployment guide, including MSI properties.

### New role: Operator

**Generate Boot Image** and pre-production boot images in **Prepare USB Storage Device** are now
available to users with `CloudImaging.Operator` on the **Cloud Imaging Media Builder** app
registration, as well as to Administrators. Technicians are unchanged.

**Administrators of existing tenants**: add `CloudImaging.Operator` to the Media Builder
registration (and to the Portal registration, which authorises the boot image upload), assign it,
and have assigned users sign out and back in. Do not change, remove or re-create any existing
role or assignment. Follow
[Add the Operator role](https://github.com/MSEndpointMgr/CloudImaging/blob/main/docs/upgrade-instructions.md#add-the-operator-role)
in the upgrade instructions, and upgrade the backend to `mse-ci-v1.1.0` as well.

### PowerShell in boot images

**Generate Boot Image** now adds the `WinPE-Scripting` and `WinPE-PowerShell` optional components
from the installed WinPE add-on, so setup profile scripts can run in WinPE. Boot images are larger
as a result. Generate new boot images with this release and update USB media to use setup
profiles; see
[Turn on setup profiles](https://github.com/MSEndpointMgr/CloudImaging/blob/main/docs/upgrade-instructions.md#turn-on-setup-profiles).

### Release artifacts
| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `cloud-imaging-mediabuilder-v1.1.0.msi` | Per-machine installer (x64). Configured via MSI properties; upgrades in place and keeps existing configuration. |
| `cloud-imaging-mediabuilder-v1.1.0.zip` | The same self-contained win-x64 payload (net10.0-windows), unpackaged, for xcopy deployment or custom packaging. |
| `SHA256SUMS` | SHA-256 checksums for integrity verification |
